title: What The Accordion Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal accordion world instruments Italian folk comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The accordion is not a subtle instrument
It enters the room with everything it has
Both hands doing different things at once
Which is the Italian way of handling Tuesday

[Verse 2]
You pull the bellows to bring the note in
You push to send it back
The accordion breathes like a person
Who has decided breathing should be dramatic

[Chorus]
What the accordion knows
Every language sounds better in it
What the accordion knows
Even silence sounds like it means something
The accordion played at the wedding, played at the wake
The accordion knows — the accordion was awake

[Bridge]
Chas heard an accordion in Rome once
Through an open window, three floors up
He said — that's the only instrument
That sounds like it's arguing with itself
And winning

[Verse 3]
The Italian verse lives in the accordion
The way a language lives in its instrument
You can't sing Italian without the accordion understanding
Just as you can't play the accordion without some Italian happening

[Outro]
What the accordion knows
What the accordion knows
The bellows breathe
The accordion knows
That's my boy
